patch_list: Exclude unrelated songs from shared albums on offline performing-artist pages (#1689). Requires the original official Finamp 1.0.1 APK. Produces ARM64-only output; other native architectures are removed.

Use the banner's matching foreground color so its text stays readable with custom accents (#1756). Requires the original official Finamp 1.0.1 APK. Produces ARM64-only output; other native architectures are removed.

Update validation and enable Save when a custom home-section title is entered (#1830). Requires the original official Finamp 1.0.1 APK. Produces ARM64-only output; other native architectures are removed.

Compare song names and target letters consistently when jumping through the Tracks alphabet (#1790). Requires the original official Finamp 1.0.1 APK. Produces ARM64-only output; other native architectures are removed.

Open the existing output controls from the player menu even when bottom actions are hidden (#1355). Requires the original official Finamp 1.0.1 APK. Produces ARM64-only output; other native architectures are removed.

Load artist previews and track counts without downloading the full discography (#1832). Requires the original official Finamp 1.0.1 APK. Produces ARM64-only output; other native architectures are removed.

Choose song-credit display order, including album artists first, metadata order and alphabetical (#1831). Requires the original official Finamp 1.0.1 APK. Produces ARM64-only output; other native architectures are removed.
